topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: Audit and backfill: README.md must mirror all user-visible features, commands, and flags currently in docs/product/backlog.md and docs/product/acceptance.md, then keep it from drifting via a blocking release-gate extension on top of US-0030.

Both root README.md and template/README.md (parity per US-0030 / US-0077) plus docs/developer/README.md for DEV_* developer-profile rows; documentation validator script and release-gate logic that consumes the validator.

Preserve US-0077 audience profiles (USER_* / DEV_* H2 vocabulary), US-0030 README / runbook parity, US-0071 user-visible metadata sanitization, US-0017 template-drift parity, and DEC-0040 artifact ordering. Skip pure-internal guards / refactors that have no user-visible surface.

New feature-coverage validator with self-test plus regression test; extend release doc-delta gate so missing user-visible feature descriptions in the README family block /release with a deterministic reason code; keep scripts/check-user-visible-metadata.py and scripts/validate_doc_profile.py green; preserve template parity tests.

Single P1 story: one-time README backfill across root README.md, template/README.md, and docs/developer/README.md, plus shipped blocking drift guard with deterministic reason codes wired into /release; release of the corresponding sprint flips US-0091 to DONE per US-0045.
